name: lines of connected belts are never joined
find:
if lines[li].line_equals(other) then
                        join(unit * LINE_KEY_STRIDE + li, other_key)

name: two lanes of one belt on the same line are never joined
find: if lines[li].line_equals(lines[lj]) then join(unit * LINE_KEY_STRIDE + li, unit * LINE_KEY_STRIDE + lj) end
replace: if false then join(unit * LINE_KEY_STRIDE + li, unit * LINE_KEY_STRIDE + lj) end

name: a connected belt outside the list is not walked
find: if shared and not queued[other_unit] then queued[other_unit] = true; order[#order + 1] = neighbour end
replace: if shared and not queued[other_unit] then queued[other_unit] = true end

name: input neighbours are ignored
find: for _, neighbour in pairs(neighbours.inputs or {}) do add(neighbour) end

name: output neighbours are ignored
find: for _, neighbour in pairs(neighbours.outputs or {}) do add(neighbour) end

name: an item on two groups' lines is not detected
a failing neighbour walk fails the capture instead of falling back
find: local partition_ok, root_of, walked, compared = pcall(partition_lines, belt_pairs)
replace: local partition_ok, root_of, walked, compared = true, partition_lines(belt_pairs)

name: group order follows the partition, not the belt list
replace: local key = root_of(bp.entity, li) if bp.entity.unit_number % 2 == 0 then key = -key end
